basic_info.description: Well-located 16-unit multifamily building in San Francisco's Nob Hill district. The property consists of sixteen one-bedroom, one-bathroom units, several of which offer Downtown city views and retain original period detailing. Each unit is separately metered for gas and electricity.  Recent upgrades include a completed soft-story seismic retrofit (2017) and compliance with the Sleep Alarm Ordinance (final sign-off pending). The building is in fair condition and presents an opportunity for renovation and income growth.  Current rents are significantly below market, with an estimated 224% rental upside achievable through unit turnover. Excellent location near public transit, employment centers, and neighborhood amenities.
